item.title: Bajaj Auto New Bikes: 8 New Motorcycles Coming by July 2026 To Revive Pulsar and Launch New 125cc Brand
item.description: Bajaj Auto will launch eight new motorcycles by mid-2026, focusing on rebuilding its Pulsar franchise in the 150cc-plus segment.
